|notes=This version was printed for the fixed decks of [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game]] (March 1997). It has a white border and a © 1996 copyright date, which sets it apart from the other white-border and Revised printings.<ref name="encyc-30">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 30: "The white-border Hoth, A New Hope, and Premiere cards included in this set included a © 1996 making them unique from other white-border or revised versions." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The game text on this printing differs from the [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)|Hoth Limited]] printing.<ref name="ice-2pg-print">Photograph of the printed ESB Two-Player game-text bars: [[:File:Hoth Ice Plains ESB Two-Player printed text.png]]. The Limited wording is on Decipher's archived cardlist image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020403172852/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/dark/small/hothiceplains.html Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)], [[Decipher]] (archived 3 April 2002).</ref> Light Side: "During your move phase, you may move (for free) between here and Mountains." Dark Side: "If Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here." The Limited printing has Light Side: "During your move phase, you may move free from here directly to Mountains (or vice versa)" and Dark Side: "If you control, and Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here."
